# TokenSpendCalc

> TokenSpendCalc (https://tokenspendcalc.com) is an enterprise B2B AI token cost calculator and cloud LLM unit economics engine. It models multi-turn conversational compounding, prompt caching discounts, context-cliff surcharges, and smart cascading model routing across 16 frontier and budget models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Meta Llama, Mistral, and AWS Bedrock).

## Canonical Domain & Sitemaps
- Canonical URL: https://tokenspendcalc.com
- Sitemap: https://tokenspendcalc.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Contact: contact@tokenspendcalc.com

## Key FinOps Capabilities
- Multi-Turn Quadratic History Compounding: (N * S) + sum(i * U + (i - 1) * O)
- Prompt Caching ROI: Up to 90% discount on pinned system prefixes and RAG chunks
- Context-Cliff Surcharge Detection: Identifies provider price doublings (e.g., 128k threshold)
- Smart Model Routing: Simulates 70/30 split between primary and budget fallback models
- 240 Head-to-Head Comparison Models
- 8 B2B Workload Architecture Presets
